event_text: The Paris Metro opens to passengers.
wikipedia_text: The first line of the Paris Metro opens.

event_text: British colonies federate to form the Commonwealth of Australia.
wikipedia_text: The British colonies of New South Wales, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Victoria and Western Australia federate as the Commonwealth of Australia; Edmund Barton becomes the first Prime Minister of Australia.

event_text: Britain and Japan sign the Anglo-Japanese Alliance.
wikipedia_text: The Anglo-Japanese Alliance is signed.

event_text: Revolutionary Gotse Delchev is killed fighting the Ottoman army.
wikipedia_text: Macedonian Bulgarian revolutionary Gotse Delchev is killed in a skirmish with the Ottoman army.

event_text: Chekhov's play The Cherry Orchard premieres at the Moscow Art Theatre.
wikipedia_text: Anton Chekhov's last play, The Cherry Orchard, opens at the Moscow Art Theatre directed by Constantin Stanislavski.

event_text: The Canadian provinces of Alberta and Saskatchewan are established.
wikipedia_text: The Canadian provinces of Alberta and Saskatchewan are established from the southwestern part of the Northwest Territories.

event_text: The All-India Muslim League is founded in Dhaka.
wikipedia_text: The All-India Muslim League is founded as a political party in Dhaka in the British Raj; it becomes a driving force for the creation of an independent Pakistan.

event_text: Oklahoma becomes a U.S. state.
wikipedia_text: President Theodore Roosevelt proclaims that Oklahoma has become the 46th U.S. state.

event_text: King Carlos of Portugal and his heir are shot dead in Lisbon.
wording_note: regnal number dropped
wikipedia_text: Lisbon Regicide: King Carlos I of Portugal and Prince Luis Filipe are shot dead in Lisbon.

event_text: The Brazilian football club Sport Club Internacional is founded in Porto Alegre.
wikipedia_text: The association football team Sport Club Internacional is founded in Porto Alegre, Brazil.

event_text: Charles Rolls dies in an aeroplane crash at Bournemouth.
wikipedia_text: Charles Rolls becomes the first British aviation fatality when his French-built Wright aeroplane suffers a broken rudder at an altitude of and crashes during a contest at Bournemouth.

event_text: The Northern Territory and the Australian Capital Territory join the Commonwealth of Australia.
wikipedia_text: A decade after federation, the Northern Territory and the Australian Capital Territory are added to the Commonwealth of Australia.

event_text: France makes Morocco a protectorate through the Treaty of Fes.
wikipedia_text: The French Third Republic establishes the French protectorate in Morocco by the Treaty of Fes with Sultan Abd al-Hafid of Morocco.

event_text: The United States Soccer Federation is formed.
wikipedia_text: The United States Soccer Federation is formed.

event_text: The Maritz Rebellion of Boers against the Union of South Africa begins.
wikipedia_text: The Maritz Rebellion of disaffected Boers against the government of the Union of South Africa begins. General Koos de la Rey, a Boer general associated with the leaders of the rebellion, is shot dead after his driver fails to stop at a police roadblock.

event_text: The Zimmerwald Conference begins in Switzerland.
wikipedia_text: The Zimmerwald Conference begins in Switzerland.

event_text: Britain and France conclude the secret Sykes-Picot Agreement.
wikipedia_text: Britain and France conclude the secret Sykes–Picot Agreement, which is to divide Arab areas of the Ottoman Empire, following the conclusion of WWI and the partitioning of the Ottoman Empire, into French and British spheres of influence.

event_text: The Japanese city of Ōmuta is officially established.
wording_note: founder name in the bullet looks like vandalism; left out
wikipedia_text: Ōmuta, Japan, is founded by Hiroushi Miruku.

event_text: Prince Frederick Charles of Hesse is elected King of Finland.
wikipedia_text: Landgrave Prince Frederick Charles of Hesse is elected King of Finland.

event_text: The Treaty of Saint-Germain is signed, dissolving the Austro-Hungarian Empire.
wording_note: clause added so it is not confused with older treaties of Saint-Germain
wikipedia_text: The Treaty of Saint-Germain is signed, ending World War I with Austria-Hungary and declaring that the latter's empire is to be dissolved. The Republic of German-Austria becomes the First Austrian Republic but retains less than 40% of the prewar imperial territory.

event_text: Warren G. Harding defeats James M. Cox for President of the United States.
wikipedia_text: 1920 United States presidential election: Republican U.S. senator Warren G. Harding defeats Democratic governor of Ohio James M. Cox and Socialist Eugene V. Debs, in the first national U.S. election in which women have the right to vote.

event_text: The International Hydrographic Bureau is established under the League of Nations.
wikipedia_text: The International Hydrographic Bureau (IHB) is established as an agency of the League of Nations; it continues in this form until April 19, 1946.

event_text: The Hollywood Bowl open-air music venue opens.
wikipedia_text: The Hollywood Bowl open-air music venue opens.

event_text: TIME magazine publishes its debut issue.
wikipedia_text: The first issue of TIME magazine is published.

event_text: A Soviet-backed communist coup attempt fails in Estonia.
wikipedia_text: A Soviet-backed communist 1924 Estonian coup d'état attempt fails in Estonia.

event_text: The Grand Ole Opry radio show debuts on WSM in Nashville.
wikipedia_text: The weekly country music-variety radio programme Grand Ole Opry is first broadcast on WSM radio in Nashville, Tennessee, as the "WSM Barn Dance".

event_text: Éamon de Valera founds the Fianna Fáil party in Ireland.
wikipedia_text: Éamon de Valera organises the political party Fianna Fáil in Ireland.

event_text: Juan Trippe founds Pan American World Airways.
wikipedia_text: Pan American World Airways is founded by Juan T. Trippe.

event_text: Warlord Zhang Zuolin is killed by Japanese agents in the Huanggutun incident.
wikipedia_text: Huanggutun incident: Zhang Zuolin, a warlord, is killed by Japanese agents in China.

event_text: Wings wins the top film award at the Academy Awards ceremony.
wikipedia_text: The 1st Academy Awards are presented in a 15-minute ceremony at the Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel, honoring the best movies of 1927 and 1928, Wings (1927) winning Best Picture. Gerald Duffy (died 1928) receives the only Academy Award for Best Title Writing ever awarded (for his intertitles to the silent film The Private Life of Helen of Troy (1927)).

event_text: The papal encyclical Casti connubii on marriage is issued.
wording_note: regnal number dropped
wikipedia_text: The Papal encyclical Casti connubii, issued by Pope Pius XI, stresses the sanctity of marriage, prohibits Roman Catholics from using any form of artificial birth control, and reaffirms the Catholic prohibition on abortion.

event_text: The George Washington Bridge over the Hudson River is dedicated.
wikipedia_text: The George Washington Bridge across the Hudson River in the United States is dedicated; it opens to traffic the following day. At , it nearly doubles the previous record for the longest main span in the world.

event_text: The BBC Empire Service begins shortwave radio broadcasting.
wikipedia_text: BBC World Service begins broadcasting as the BBC Empire Service using a shortwave radio facility at its Daventry transmitting station in England.

event_text: The Montevideo Convention on the Rights and Duties of States is signed.
wikipedia_text: Montevideo Convention on the Rights and Duties of States is signed by participants in the 7th International Conference of American States; it is significant in the development of the declarative theory of statehood.

event_text: Hitler becomes Führer of Germany after President Hindenburg dies.
wikipedia_text: Adolf Hitler becomes Führer of Germany, or head of state combined with that of Chancellor, following the death of President Paul von Hindenburg.

event_text: The Hanshin Tigers baseball club is founded in Osaka, Japan.
wikipedia_text: Hanshin Tigers, a well known professional baseball club of Japan, is founded in Osaka.

event_text: The film Modern Times premieres in New York City.
wording_note: "Modern" is part of the film's title
wikipedia_text: Modern Times, widely considered one of the greatest films ever, premieres in New York City.

event_text: The airship Hindenburg bursts into flames at Lakehurst, New Jersey.
wikipedia_text: Hindenburg disaster: In the United States, the German airship Hindenburg bursts into flame when mooring to a mast in Lakehurst, New Jersey. Of the 36 passengers and 61 crew on board, 13 passengers and 22 crew die, as well as one member of the ground crew.

event_text: France's state railway company SNCF is created by merger.
wikipedia_text: State-owned railway networks are created by merger, in France (SNCF) and the Netherlands (Nederlandse Spoorwegen – NS).

event_text: The Soviet Union sets up the Finnish Democratic Republic puppet state.
wikipedia_text: The Soviet Union establishes the Finnish Democratic Republic puppet state in Terijoki.

event_text: British sailors free prisoners from the German tanker Altmark in Norwegian waters.
wording_note: war label dropped
wikipedia_text: WWII: Altmark incident – British destroyer pursues German tanker Altmark into the neutral waters of the Jøssingfjorden in southwestern Norway and frees the 290 British seamen held aboard.

event_text: Franklin D. Roosevelt opens the National Gallery of Art in Washington.
wikipedia_text: In Washington, D.C., the National Gallery of Art is officially opened by President Franklin D. Roosevelt.

event_text: Germany test-flies the Messerschmitt jet fighter using only its jet engines.
wording_note: aircraft number dropped
wikipedia_text: WWII: The Germans test fly the Messerschmitt Me 262 (using only its jet engines) for the first time.

event_text: King Boris of Bulgaria dies under suspicious circumstances.
wording_note: regnal number dropped
wikipedia_text: WWII: King Boris III of Bulgaria dies under suspicious circumstances; his 6-year-old son, Simeon II, ascends to the throne.

event_text: Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg sign the customs convention creating Benelux.
wikipedia_text: Belgium, Netherlands and Luxembourg constitute Benelux as representatives of the exiled governments sign the London Customs Convention.

event_text: The Allied Control Council formally takes power over occupied Germany.
wikipedia_text: The Allied Control Council, the military occupation governing body of Germany, formally takes power.

event_text: Hungary formally abolishes its long-vacant monarchy and becomes a republic.
wording_note: "long-vacant" separates it from the earlier Hungarian republic
wikipedia_text: The Kingdom of Hungary becomes a republic, heavily influenced by the Soviet Union.

event_text: The Constitution of Japan goes into effect.
wikipedia_text: The new post-war Constitution of Japan goes into effect.

event_text: The International Union for the Protection of Nature is founded in France.
wikipedia_text: The International Union for the Protection of Nature (later known as the International Union for Conservation of Nature, IUCN) is established in Fontainebleau, France.
matched_article: International Union for Conservation of Nature

event_text: The Soviet-led economic bloc Comecon is established.
wikipedia_text: The Council for Mutual Economic Assistance (CMEA or COMECON) is established by the Soviet Union and other communist nations.

event_text: India's constitution takes effect and the country becomes a republic.
wikipedia_text: India promulgates its constitution, forming a republic, and Rajendra Prasad is sworn in as its first president. The Kingdom of Mysore is merged into the new republic.

event_text: The Festival of Britain opens in London with the Royal Festival Hall.
wording_note: regnal number dropped
wikipedia_text: King George VI opens the Festival of Britain in London, including the Royal Festival Hall.

event_text: Princess Elizabeth becomes Queen of the United Kingdom.
wikipedia_text: Princess Elizabeth, Duchess of Edinburgh, becomes monarch of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland and the British Dominions: Canada, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, Pakistan and Ceylon. The princess, who is on a visit to Kenya when she hears of the death of her father, King George VI, aged 56, takes the regnal name Elizabeth II.

event_text: The Academy Awards ceremony is held partly at New York's NBC International Theatre.
wording_note: only ceremony held at that theatre
wikipedia_text: The 25th Academy Awards Ceremony is held (the first one broadcast on television).

event_text: West Germany beats Hungary to win the World Cup in Bern.
wikipedia_text: "Miracle of Bern": West Germany beats Hungary 3–2 to win the 1954 FIFA World Cup.

event_text: A crash at the Le Mans motor race kills many spectators.
wikipedia_text: Le Mans disaster: Eighty-three people are killed when two racing cars collide in the 1955 24 Hours of Le Mans.

event_text: The Hungarian Revolution against the pro-Soviet government breaks out.
wikipedia_text: The Hungarian Revolution breaks out against the pro-Soviet government, originating as a student demonstration in Budapest. Hungary attempts to leave the Warsaw Pact.

event_text: Haakon dies and his son Olav becomes King of Norway.
wording_note: regnal numbers dropped; a medieval Haakon-to-Olav succession also exists
wikipedia_text: Olav V becomes King of Norway on the death of his father Haakon VII.

event_text: The United States launches Vanguard, a solar-powered satellite.
wording_note: separates it from later Vanguard satellites
wikipedia_text: The United States launches the Vanguard 1 satellite.

event_text: Hawaii is admitted as a U.S. state.
wikipedia_text: Hawaii is admitted as the 50th and last U.S. state.

event_text: Dahomey (Benin) gains independence from France.
wikipedia_text: Dahomey (modern-day Benin) becomes independent from France.

event_text: Tanganyika gains independence from the United Kingdom under Julius Nyerere.
wikipedia_text: Tanganyika gains independence from the United Kingdom as a Commonwealth realm, with Julius Nyerere as its first Prime Minister, with Queen Elizabeth II as Queen of Tanganyika, and represented locally by the Governor-General of Tanganyika.

event_text: John Glenn orbits the Earth in a Mercury spacecraft.
wording_note: spacecraft name dropped (it contains a number)
wikipedia_text: Project Mercury: Aboard Friendship 7, John Glenn becomes the first American to orbit the Earth, three times in 4 hours, 55 minutes.

event_text: NASA launches astronaut Gordon Cooper on a solo Mercury orbital mission.
wikipedia_text: Project Mercury: NASA launches Gordon Cooper on Mercury-Atlas 9, the last Mercury mission (on June 12 NASA Administrator James E. Webb tells Congress the program is complete).

event_text: The Forth Road Bridge opens in Scotland.
wikipedia_text: The Forth Road Bridge opens over the Firth of Forth in Scotland.

event_text: Canada adopts the maple leaf flag.
wikipedia_text: The maple leaf is adopted as the flag of Canada, replacing the Canadian Red Ensign flag.

event_text: The FIFA World Cup tournament begins in England.
wikipedia_text: The 1966 FIFA World Cup begins in England.

event_text: Ilse Koch, the Witch of Buchenwald, dies by suicide in prison.
wikipedia_text: Ilse Koch, known as the "Witch of Buchenwald", commits suicide in the Bavarian prison of Aichach.

event_text: Robert F. Kennedy is shot at the Ambassador Hotel in Los Angeles.
wikipedia_text: Assassination of Robert F. Kennedy: Senator Robert F. Kennedy, a leading 1968 Democratic presidential candidate, is shot at the Ambassador Hotel in Los Angeles. Palestinian-born Sirhan Sirhan is arrested.

event_text: Meredith Hunter is stabbed to death at the Altamont Free Concert.
wikipedia_text: Meredith Hunter is stabbed to death by Hells Angels at the Altamont Free Concert, an event which came to be viewed as the end of the hippie era and the de facto conclusion of late-1960s American youth culture.

event_text: Japan launches the satellite Ohsumi on a Lambda rocket.
wikipedia_text: Ohsumi, Japan's first satellite, is launched on a Lambda-4 rocket.

event_text: Sierra Leone becomes a republic.
wikipedia_text: Sierra Leone becomes a republic.

event_text: Watergate burglars are arrested at the Democratic National Committee offices.
wikipedia_text: Watergate scandal: Five White House operatives are arrested for burgling the offices of the Democratic National Committee.

event_text: India launches the tiger conservation program Project Tiger.
wikipedia_text: India launches the wildlife conservation program Project Tiger.

event_text: A Turkish Airlines jet from Paris to London crashes, killing everyone aboard.
wording_note: flight number dropped
wikipedia_text: Turkish Airlines Flight 981, travelling from Paris to London, crashes in the woods near Paris, killing all 346 aboard. This was the deadliest aircraft accident in history up to this time, and remains the deadliest single aircraft accident with no survivors.

event_text: Madagascar's president Richard Ratsimandrava is assassinated.
wikipedia_text: Colonel Richard Ratsimandrava, President of Madagascar, is assassinated.

event_text: The Soweto uprising begins in South Africa.
wikipedia_text: The Soweto uprising in South Africa begins.

event_text: Jimmy Carter signs the law creating the U.S. Department of Energy.
wikipedia_text: U.S. president Jimmy Carter signs legislation creating the United States Department of Energy.

event_text: Iranian troops fire on protesters in Tehran on Black Friday.
wikipedia_text: Iranian Army troops open fire on rioters in Tehran, killing 122, wounding over 200.

event_text: Nazi criminal Josef Mengele drowns while swimming in Brazil.
wikipedia_text: Nazi criminal Josef Mengele suffers a fatal stroke and drowns while swimming in Bertioga, Brazil. His remains are found in 1985.

event_text: John Lennon is murdered outside his New York City apartment building.
wikipedia_text: Murder of John Lennon: Mark David Chapman is arrested following the murder of English musician John Lennon, formerly of the Beatles, outside his New York City apartment building, The Dakota.

event_text: MTV launches as a round-the-clock music video channel.
wikipedia_text: The first 24-hour video music channel MTV (Music Television) is launched in the United States and airs its first video, "Video Killed the Radio Star" by The Buggles.

event_text: Chariots of Fire wins Best Picture at the Academy Awards.
wikipedia_text: The 54th Academy Awards, hosted by Johnny Carson, are held at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion in Los Angeles. Chariots of Fire wins Best Picture and 3 other Academy Awards.

event_text: War breaks out between Sudan's government and the Sudan People's Liberation Army.
wording_source: article lead: Second Sudanese Civil War
wording_note: separates it from the earlier Sudanese civil war
wikipedia_text: The Second Sudanese Civil War begins in Sudan.

event_text: A gunman kills people at a McDonald's in San Ysidro, San Diego.
wikipedia_text: San Ysidro McDonald's massacre: 41-year-old James Huberty walks into a McDonald's in the San Ysidro district of San Diego, resulting in 21 deaths, with Huberty being killed by a sniper 77 minutes after the ordeal begins.

event_text: The Australian soap opera Neighbours debuts on television.
wikipedia_text: Australia's longest-running soap opera, Neighbours, debuts on Seven Network.

event_text: Jeltoqsan protests break out in Soviet Kazakhstan.
wikipedia_text: Jeltoqsan, mass anti-government protests, break out across the Kazakh SSR, resulting in the massacre of over 165 protesters.

event_text: The Brundtland Commission publishes its report Our Common Future.
wikipedia_text: The World Commission on Environment and Development, also known as the Brundtland Commission, publishes its report, Our Common Future.

event_text: Pakistan's president Zia-ul-Haq dies in a plane crash.
wikipedia_text: Pakistani President Muhammad Zia-ul-Haq and the U.S. ambassador to Pakistan, Arnold Lewis Raphel, are among those killed when a plane crashes and explodes near Bahawalpur.

event_text: Soviet troops kill demonstrators at a rally in Tbilisi, Georgia.
wikipedia_text: Tbilisi massacre: Georgian demonstrators are massacred by Soviet Army soldiers in Tbilisi's central square during a peaceful rally; 20 citizens are killed, many injured. This causes further protests.

event_text: The Rwandan Patriotic Front invades Rwanda from Uganda, starting a civil war.
wikipedia_text: The rebel Rwandan Patriotic Front invades Rwanda from Uganda, marking the start of the Rwandan Civil War.

event_text: The Unrepresented Nations and Peoples Organization is founded in The Hague.
wikipedia_text: The Unrepresented Nations and Peoples Organization (UNPO) is formed in The Hague, Netherlands.

event_text: A Sicilian Mafia car bomb kills judge Paolo Borsellino.
wikipedia_text: Via D'Amelio bombing: A car bomb placed by the Sicilian Mafia (with the collaboration of Italian intelligence) kills judge Paolo Borsellino and five members of his police escort.

event_text: Members of Austria's Freedom Party split off to form the Liberal Forum.
wikipedia_text: Members of the right-wing Austrian Freedom Party of Austria split to form the Liberal Forum in protest against the increasing nationalistic bent of the party.

event_text: Palau gains independence from a United Nations trusteeship.
wikipedia_text: Palau gains independence from the United Nations Trusteeship Council.

event_text: Quebec voters narrowly reject independence from Canada in a referendum.
wording_note: "narrowly" separates it from Quebec's earlier referendum
wikipedia_text: Quebec independentists narrowly lose a referendum for a mandate to negotiate independence from Canada.

event_text: A Birgenair charter jet crashes into the Atlantic off the Dominican Republic.
wording_note: flight number dropped
wikipedia_text: Birgenair Flight 301, on a charter flight from the Caribbean to Germany, crashes into the Atlantic Ocean off the coast of the Dominican Republic, killing all 189 passengers and crew.

event_text: Armored bank robbers fight police in the North Hollywood shootout.
wikipedia_text: North Hollywood shootout: Two robbers, wearing kevlar body armor, and armed with illegally modified Type 56S rifles with high-capacity magazines and other weapons, injure 20 police officers and civilians in a gun battle. The incident sparks debate on the appropriate firepower for United States patrol officers to have available in similar situations in the future.

event_text: The European Central Bank is established.
wikipedia_text: The European Central Bank is established, replacing the European Monetary Institute.

event_text: The Santer Commission of the European Union resigns over corruption allegations.
wikipedia_text: The Santer Commission of the EU resigns over allegations of corruption.

event_text: Real Madrid beats Valencia to win the UEFA Champions League.
wikipedia_text: Real Madrid C.F. defeats Valencia CF 3–0 in the UEFA Champions League Final at Stade de France to win their second title between 1998 and 2002, and their eighth overall.

event_text: Apple releases its Mac operating system codenamed Cheetah.
wording_note: version name dropped (it contains a numeral)
wikipedia_text: Apple Inc. released the Mac OS X operating system for Mac computers.

event_text: NASA launches the Aqua Earth-observing satellite.
wikipedia_text: NASA launches the Aqua satellite as part of the Earth Observing System.

event_text: The Canal Hotel bombing in Baghdad kills UN envoy Sérgio Vieira de Mello.
wikipedia_text: In the Canal Hotel bombing in Baghdad, 22 people are killed, among them United Nations' Special Representative in Iraq Sérgio Vieira de Mello.

event_text: NASA launches the MESSENGER probe to study Mercury.
wikipedia_text: NASA's MESSENGER space probe is launched, with its primary mission being the study of Mercury.

event_text: Tony Blair's Labour wins a British general election with a sharply reduced majority.
wording_source: article lead: 2005 United Kingdom general election
wording_note: separates it from Blair's other election wins
wikipedia_text: The 2005 United Kingdom general election is won by Prime Minister Tony Blair and the Labour Party for a third consecutive majority government.

event_text: NASA launches the New Horizons probe to Pluto.
wikipedia_text: NASA launches the first interplanetary space probe to Pluto, the New Horizons.

event_text: European Union members sign the Treaty of Lisbon.
wikipedia_text: The Treaty of Lisbon is signed by members states of European Union.

event_text: ESA launches the Jules Verne cargo spacecraft to the International Space Station.
wording_note: separates it from later cargo spacecraft of the same type
wikipedia_text: The first European Space Agency Automated Transfer Vehicle, a cargo spacecraft for the International Space Station, launches from Guiana Space Centre in French Guiana.

event_text: An earthquake devastates L'Aquila, Italy.
wikipedia_text: A 6.3 magnitude earthquake strikes near L'Aquila, Italy, killing 308 and injuring more than 1,500.

event_text: An Airblue passenger jet crashes near Islamabad, killing everyone aboard.
wording_note: flight number dropped
wikipedia_text: Airblue Flight 202 crashes near Islamabad, Pakistan, killing all 152 people on board.

event_text: A bomb kills Coptic Christians leaving a church in Alexandria, Egypt.
wikipedia_text: A bomb explodes as Coptic Christians in Alexandria, Egypt leave a new year service, killing 23 people.

event_text: Felix Baumgartner skydives from the stratosphere in the Red Bull Stratos jump.
wikipedia_text: Austrian skydiver Felix Baumgartner becomes the first person to break the sound barrier without any machine assistance, during a record space dive out of the Red Bull Stratos helium-filled balloon from 128,000 ft () over Roswell, New Mexico in the United States.

event_text: Countries sign the Minamata Convention to limit mercury pollution.
wikipedia_text: Delegates from some 140 countries and territories sign the Minamata Treaty, a UNEP treaty designed to protect human health and the environment from emissions and releases of mercury and mercury compounds.

event_text: Knife-wielding attackers kill many people at Kunming railway station in China.
wikipedia_text: 2014 Kunming attack: Eight knife-wielding terrorists stabbed and slashed passengers at the Kunming railway station in Kunming, Yunnan, China, killing 31 people and injuring 143 others.

event_text: Al-Shabaab gunmen kill students at Garissa University College in Kenya.
wikipedia_text: 148 people are killed, the majority students, in a mass shooting at the Garissa University College in Kenya, perpetrated by the militant terrorist organization al-Shabaab.

event_text: Italian voters reject a constitutional referendum and Matteo Renzi resigns.
wikipedia_text: A constitutional referendum is held in Italy, resulting in the resignation of Prime Minister Matteo Renzi.

event_text: Kim Jong-nam, half-brother of Kim Jong-un, is killed with a nerve agent.
wikipedia_text: Assassination of Kim Jong-nam: Kim Jong-nam, the eldest son of deceased North Korean leader Kim Jong-il and the half-brother of current North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, is killed after being attacked by two women with VX nerve agent at Kuala Lumpur International Airport in Malaysia.

event_text: Turkey launches a military offensive against Kurdish forces in Afrin, Syria.
wikipedia_text: Turkey, led by President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, announces the beginning of a military offensive to capture a portion of northern Syria from Kurdish forces, amidst the ongoing Kurdish–Turkish conflict.

event_text: In Estonia's parliamentary election, Reform stays largest as the Conservative People's Party surges.
wording_note: separates it from other Estonian elections
wikipedia_text: The 2019 Estonian parliamentary election is held to elect all 101 members of the Riigikogu.
